sloka: स्वस्थाः पश्यत दुर्धर्षा युद्धं वानरपुङ्गवाः ।आसीनाः पर्वताग्रेषु ममेदं रावणस्य च ।। ६.१०१.५५ ।।
transliteration: svasthāḥ paśyata durdharṣā yuddhaṁ vānarapuṅgavāḥ ।āsīnāḥ parvatāgreṣu mamedaṁ rāvaṇasya ca ।। 6.101.55 ।।

translations.english: 'Today I shall do such a deed as the worlds with all that moves and moves not, gods included, shall recount so long as the earth endures — telling ever, when men gather together, how this battle was fought.'
